item.title: Inline chat inserts content instead of updating it

labels.name: info-needed
labels.description: Issue requires more information from poster

item.body:
Type: Bug When asking Copilot to modify a file with no selected text, it will only modify the current line (where the cursor is at). When asked to modify the entire file, it will insert the correctly modified (but out of place) text in said line. ## Steps to reproduce 1. Load a file with some lines of text. 2. Start Copilot inline chat. 3. Ask it to make a modification. It will modify just the line where the cursor is at. 4. Then ask him to modify text elsewhere. ### Expected behaviour Copilot modifies the rest of the file ### Actual behaviour Copilot inserts a copy of the modified text in the line where the cursor is at.
